question: The Hans Sect is a major sect, with followers primarily worshiping Lord □( ).
solution:
The correct answer is __**Krishna and Radha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Hans Sect primarily worships **Lord Krishna and Radha** as their principal deities.
 
• Lord Krishna is a central figure in Hinduism, known for his teachings in the Bhagavad Gita and his role in the Mahabharata.
 
• Radha, often considered the supreme goddess, is revered as the consort of Krishna and embodies devotion and love.
 
• The worship of Krishna and Radha emphasizes **bhakti (devotion)** and is an integral part of the Vaishnavism tradition within Hinduism.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lord Shiva**

 
 
• Shiva, also known as Mahadeva, is one of the principal deities of Hinduism, known as "The Destroyer" within the Trimurti, the Hindu trinity that includes Brahma and Vishnu.
 
• He is worshipped as the supreme god in Shaivism, one of the major traditions within Hinduism.
 
• Shiva is often depicted with a third eye on his forehead, a serpent around his neck, and a trident in his hand.
 
 
 
• **Rama and Sita**
 
 
• Rama is the seventh avatar of the god Vishnu, and Sita is his wife, revered as an incarnation of Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity.
 
• The story of Rama and Sita is told in the ancient Indian epic, the Ramayana, which depicts Rama's quest to rescue Sita from the demon king Ravana.
 
• Their tale is celebrated in Hindu festivals like Diwali and Navaratri.
 
 
 
• **Indra**
 
 
• Indra is a Vedic deity in Hinduism, a guardian deity in Buddhism, and the king of the highest heaven called Saudharmakalpa in Jainism.
 
• He is the god of the heavens, lightning, thunder, storms, rains, river flows, and war.
 
• Indra is celebrated in numerous hymns of the Rigveda, an ancient Indian collection of Vedic Sanskrit hymns.
